Name: Kaijou War Chief
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Leading a substantial Kaijou community there will either be a proper leader chosen by some form of consensus, or (such as in the case of the kaijou of the Cauldron) there will stand a leader who has earned their title by strength and intimidation. These warchiefs are imposing, massive figures who wield huge stone weaponry and command such resonant voices that their roar itself can tear the earth apart.

The kaijou of the Cauldron have historically been led by the monolithic blue goliath known as Val Tonitruum, who killed the previous leader and has sat on her throne for over a century. Val is a hoarder of wealth and power, and so has taken to war with the nephilim who he believes are hiding ancient weapons and secret magics. He was the wielder of the constellequary Germanicus, the golden axe of Harros, and its presence demanded respect and fear among his people. As of recent changes in Pezodromos, the nephilim have attempted to make peace with Val, and he has lost his grasp of Germanicus.

traits.name: Concussive Critical
traits.description: When the kaijou scores a critical hit by way of a d20 result (not one automatically triggered), the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are stunned until the start of the kaijou’s next turn.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.description: The kaijou has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Even when frightened, no effect can force them to flee from the source of their fear unless they would do so for other purposes.

traits.name: Prehistoric Strength
traits.description: When the kaijou rolls a Strength check and the d20 result is 9 or less, they can treat the d20 result as a 10 instead. They have advantage on all Strength checks made to make or break grapples.

traits.name: Zealous Rage of Defiance (1/Rest)
traits.description: When the kaijou is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, it instead is reset to 100 hit points and flies into a rage for 1 minute. During this time its attacks have advantage, all attacks against it have advantage, its movement speed doubles, and it makes one extra weapon attack each turn as part of its Multiattack. If reduced to 0 hit points again or killed outright while in this rage, it is instead reduced to 1 hit points and the rage ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kaijou uses its Primal Fear, then makes three melee weapon attacks or uses Thunder Bark.

actions.name: Stone Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Thunder Bark (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The kaijou ferociously roars, unleashing a wave of pure force that emanates from them in a 60-foot-cone. Each creature in range must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (8d10 + 10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any creature that fails by 5 points or more is deafened for 1 minute, and may repeat the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Primal Fear
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet of the kaijou that can see or hear it is subjected to the beast’s attention, and must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is frightened of the kaijou until the start of the kaijou’s next turn, and during that time the kaijou’s weapon attacks against them deal an extra 7 (1d12) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Command Subordinate
bonus_actions.description: The kaijou commands up to two beasts or humanoids under its command to attack. Those creatures can use their reactions to move up to half their movement speed and make a single weapon attack against a creature within range. If desired, both commands can be given to the same creature, which can then move up to its full movement speed and make two attacks instead.

options.name: Earthquake Stomp
options.description: The kaijou slams its foot on the ground causing it to shake. All creatures within 10 feet of the kaijou must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, falling prone on a failure.

options.name: Wrestle
options.description: The kaijou makes a grapple attempt against a Large or smaller creature within range, who must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 19). The kaijou loses one of its weapon attacks per turn while grappling this creature, unless that attack is made against the grappled creature.

options.name: Force of Personality (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The kaijou and up to 3 of its allies within 30 feet that can see or hear it gain 20 (3d12) temporary hit points, and the next attack each makes before the end of their next turn has advantage.
